service.description: Suggested reorder levels of products at a facility: per product its average daily demand over the history (what was issued from the facility and those under it), its lead time (its supplier's standard lead time, else the one given), the safety stock (the safety days of demand), and the suggested minimum (demand over the lead time plus the safety stock) and maximum (the minimum plus the cover days of demand), in whole units. The products given, else those with a rule at the facility (at most 200). A product without demand history (NO_DEMAND_HISTORY) or without a lead time (NO_LEAD_TIME) is named and gets no suggestion. Writes nothing. Requires STOCK_POLICY_PLAN or STOCK_POLICY_MANAGE (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses a facility outside the user's organizations and history, safety, cover or lead days out of range (LEVELS_INVALID).

parameter.name: leadTimeDays
parameter.description: For a product with no supplier lead time.

parameter.name: levelRows
parameter.description: Per product: productId, pseudoId, productName, facilityId, currentMinimum, currentMaximum, reorderMethodEnumId, ok, averageDailyDemand, leadTimeDays, leadTimeSource, safetyStock, suggestedMinimum and suggestedMaximum, or reasonCode and message.

service.description: Apply levels to products' reorder rules: each row's minimum and maximum stock (and the reorder method given) through FacilityServices.store#ProductFacilityPolicy, in its own transaction with the reason given, so a row the store refuses (its permission, organization or level checks) is named with its reason and the other rows are kept. Refuses no reason (REASON_REQUIRED) and no rows (ROWS_REQUIRED); a row without a minimum is named (LEVELS_REQUIRED).

parameter.name: facilityId
parameter.description: The facility of rows that name none.

parameter.name: levelRows
parameter.description: Each with productId, facilityId, minimumStock and maximumStock.

parameter.name: results
parameter.description: Per row: productId, facilityId, ok, reasonCode and message.

service.description: The catalog import's validator of a reorder-rule row (kind reorderRules, data/ReorderRuleImportData.xml): the facility of the import's organization, the update mode against the rule there, and the values checked by store#ProductFacilityPolicy's own rules without writing; the normalized parameters are the store's, which the import then calls for the row.
